jobs.description: Is it your passion to optimize value across portfolios, systems and products within a global Cost and Value Engineering function? Then join our team as a Senior Cost and Value Engineer for Value Management and Value Engineering (f/m/d) and actively drive sustainable value optimizations in a cross-functional environment at Siemens AG.What we offer you- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefitsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.Your success is grounded in- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. You'll be a trusted partner to Operations, Engineering, and Finance leadership, shaping how HelloFresh invests in and runs its production network. The role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Design and execute category strategies: spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier landscape assessments, and sourcing roadmaps- Lead complex RFx events and negotiate high-value contracts delivering TCO savings,not just unit price reductions- Build and manage preferred supplier portfolio per category: qualification, KPIs, and continuous improvement- Partner with senior stakeholders in Operations, Engineering, and Finance across multiple European markets- Translate business needs into procurement strategies proactively.- Drive governance and best-practice adoption: contract management, supplier risk, and compliance- Present category strategies and sourcing outcomes clearly to Director and VP-level audiences- Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in CapEx, MHE, etc. projects.What you’ll bring- 5+ years in indirect or operations procurement, with genuine category depth, not surface-level exposure- Multi-category experience in an operations or manufacturing environment (FM, MRO,, Utilities, etc.); the broader and deeper, the stronger the profile- Proven strategic sourcing skills: RFx design, complex negotiation, and contract structuring for technically complex purchases- Track record of influencing and building trust with senior, cross-functional stakeholders across European markets- Fluent in English; German and/or French language skills are a plus- Strong analytical mindset:spend data, cost modelling, benchmarking, and business case development- Able to travel to production sites across Europe, if required.Please submit your resume in English.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Initially we offer 2 years contract.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Einkauf, Beschaffung

Bei HelloFresh ist unsere Mission einfach: To change the way people, eat forever. Als globales, digital-natives FMCG-Unternehmen und weltweit führender Anbieter von Kochboxen gestalten wir die traditionelle Lebensmittel-Lieferkette neu - mit einem datengetriebenen On-Demand-Modell, das skalierbares Wachstum ermöglicht und Lebensmittel nachhaltiger liefert. Zur HelloFresh Group gehören acht Marken, darunter HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate und Chef Plate sowie Ready-to-eat Angebote von Factor und YouFoodz, Fleisch- und Meeeresfrüchte Abonnements von Good Chop und Tiernahrung von The Pets Table. Durch Technologie, Daten und kulinarische Innovation schaffen wir personalisierte Food-Erlebnisse für Millionen von Haushalten weltweit.The role:What's in the BoxAs a Strategic Demand Capacity Planner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the long-term alignment between European market demand and our global supplier, production, and logistics networks. Sitting within the Central Planning team and nested in the International Operations department, you will report directly to the Associate Director of Strategic Planning.Your mission is to bridge the gap between commercial ambition and operational reality. By working closely with Product, Marketing, and Forecasting teams, you will translate long-range demand signals into actionable capacity strategies, ensuring our network is prepared for future growth and evolving market shifts.Please note that this position is a 24-month fixed-term contract (with the aim of converting it to a permanent position afterwards).What you’ll do: The Recipe- Support the Forecasting team in developing a long-term forecast for strategic decision-making.- Conduct industry research on supplier and logistics network trends, as well as developments in digital technology for planning tools.- Analyze and monitor capacity utilization in our operational country clusters (suppliers, production, logistics network), enabling proactive risk management of our supply chain rather than reactive, wasteful incident handling.- Assist in scenario planning and ad-hoc simulations on our supplier and fulfillment network for demand alteration activities affecting our end-to-end capacities- Translate forecasted demand into actionable procurement and production plans, making tactical decisions to prevent financial waste- Promote the development and implementation of the HelloFresh Planning Target Operating Model including the deployment of an Advanced Planning ToolWhat you’ll bring: The Ingredients- 4+ years of professional experience in a similar role.- A university degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.- Initial experience in strategic roles at the intersection of demand and supply, or a background in consulting, is considered an advantage.- Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to inform decision-making.- Interest in senior stakeholder management and a desire to drive value by orchestrating cross-functional problem-solving initiatives across operational functions.- Effective communication skills in English; German language skills are a plus. Ability to collaborate across international and cross-functional teams.- A business-oriented mindset combined with a data- and process-driven approach to work.What we offer: The ToppingsElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Are you the missing ingredient?If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.
